subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 2: Team Talk – I’ve no idea! I get it!
outcomes: Find information in the Team Talk dialogue.
Use I've no idea. / That's cool! / I get it. in short dialogues.
Answer questions about a dialogue in complete sentences.

tf.s: Frank has been a puppeteer since he was eight.
tf.why: Yes, he started when he was eight.

tf.s: Majid's uncle is a sound editor.
Frank's costume is a bit small now.
tf.why: Yes, he has had it for a long time.

tf.s: We say “I've no idea” when we don't know the answer.
tf.why: Right, it means I don't know.

tf.s: We say “I get it” when we don't understand a joke.
tf.why: I get it means I understand.

tf.s: The joke Nobody Nose is funny because nose sounds like knows.
tf.why: Yes, it also means nobody knows.

tf.s: Frank has been ready since lunchtime.
tf.why: Correct, he was ready since lunchtime.
He's had it for a long time.

tf.s: “That's cool!” shows you think something is great.
tf.why: Yes, we say it when we like something.

tf.s: Ali told Frank and Majid to come on because the show was finished.
tf.why: It was time for the WOW! Talent Show to start.

boxes.why: Use I've no idea when you don't know.

boxes.q: My aunt is a TV presenter. – Wow! That's ___!
boxes.why: That's cool! shows you are impressed.

boxes.q: Do you get the joke? – Yes, I ___ it!
Majid's uncle makes people laugh. His job is ___.
How long has Frank had his costume?
boxes.why: He's had it for a long time.

boxes.q: Is Frank's costume too big or a bit small?
In the joke, nose sounds like ___.
boxes.why: Nose and knows sound the same.

boxes.q: What is the show in the dialogue?
boxes.why: They are getting ready for the WOW! Talent Show.

boxes.q: Which answer is a complete sentence?
o: Frank has been ready since lunchtime.
boxes.why: A complete sentence has a subject and a verb.

boxes.q: Who has been a puppeteer since he was eight?

mcq.q: Which expression do you use when you don't know the answer?
mcq.why: I've no idea = I don't know.

mcq.q: How long has Frank been a puppeteer?
mcq.why: He started when he was eight.

mcq.q: What job does Majid's uncle do?
Which expression shows you understand something?
A: My brother is a stunt performer. B: ___
mcq.why: That's cool! shows you are impressed.

mcq.q: Write a complete answer: Since when has Frank been ready?
o: Frank has been ready since lunchtime.
mcq.why: Use the question words to make a full sentence.

mcq.q: A: Do you get the joke? Which reply shows you understand it?
o: Yes, I get it! It's really funny.
mcq.why: I get it shows you understand.

mcq.q: Why is the joke Nobody Nose funny?
o: Nose sounds like knows, so it also means nobody knows.
Because the puppet has a big nose.
mcq.why: Words that sound the same can make jokes.

mcq.q: Frank has had his costume for a long time. Why is it a bit small now?
o: Frank has grown bigger since he got it.
mcq.why: Children grow, so old clothes get small.

mcq.q: Why did Ali tell Frank and Majid to come on?
o: It was time for the WOW! Talent Show.
